title: Acyclicity under concatenation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $gs$ and $hs$ be finite lists of gates. Their concatenation is acyclic starting from index bound $n$ if and only if $gs$ is acyclic starting from $n$ and $hs$ is acyclic starting from $n+|gs|$, where $|gs|$ is the number of gates in $gs$.
hypotheses_covered: $gs$ and $hs$ are finite lists of gates
